__inputs.name: DS_MYSQL
__inputs.label: MySQL (Subscription)
__inputs.description: MySQL — tbl_user_payment, tbl_price, tbl_gateway. amount = ریال

title: DDM Quarterly KPI Dashboard
description: رصد فصلی KPIهای DDM — Daily Pulse، In-App Revenue، Trial Funnel، B2B، Content، Health Alerts. منبع: quarterly-1404-report.md + KPI v3.

list.name: via
list.label: Product / محصول
list.query: All : 1,2,3,4,5 , VOD : 1 , Magazine : 2 , Cinema : 3 , TV : 4 , UGC : 5

panels.title: DAU — Identified Active Users
panels.description: کاربر unique با watch ≥ ${watch_min} ثانیه. anonymous حذف.

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, uniqExact(user_id) AS dau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= ${watch_min} AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Watch Hours + Avg Min/User
panels.description: کل ساعت تماشا روزانه + میانگین دقیقه per user

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(created_at) AS time, round(sum(watch_duration) / 3600.0) AS total_hours, round((sum(watch_duration) / 60.0) / nullIf(uniqExact(user_id), 0), 1) AS avg_min_per_user FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 10 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS dau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= ${watch_min} AND created_at >= toStartOfDay(now())
SELECT uniqExact(user_id) AS mau FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= ${watch_min} AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY

SELECT round(100 * uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= toStartOfDay(now())) / nullIf(uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 28 DAY), 0), 1) AS stickiness FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= ${watch_min}

panels.title: Daily Paid Revenue (NET، Toman)
panels.description: Gross/۱۰ (ریال→تومان) × ۰.۷۸۷ (پس از کارمزد ۲۱.۳٪). status=41، platform_id=1، بدون test.sandbox.

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, ROUND(SUM(up.amount) / 10 * 0.787) AS net_toman FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND up.gateway_id IN (${gateway:csv}) AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, COUNT(*) AS txn FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND up.gateway_id IN (${gateway:csv}) AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Cafebazaar vs Myket — NET Toman (روزانه stacked)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, CASE up.gateway_id WHEN 2 THEN 'Cafebazaar' WHEN 3 THEN 'Myket' ELSE 'Other' END AS gw, ROUND(SUM(up.amount)/10 * 0.787) AS net_toman FROM tbl_user_payment up WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time, gw ORDER BY time

SELECT p.name AS plan, COUNT(*) AS payments, COUNT(DISTINCT up.user_id) AS payers, ROUND(SUM(up.amount)/10 * 0.787) AS net_toman, ROUND(SUM(up.amount)/10 * 0.787 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT up.user_id),0)) AS arppu FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND up.gateway_id IN (${gateway:csv}) AND (JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment') IS NULL OR JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(up.details,'$.environment')) != 'test.sandbox') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY p.id, p.name ORDER BY net_toman DESC

panels.title: Trial DRAFTs Daily
panels.description: تراکنش‌های ایجاد شده برای ترایال (status=12 DRAFT، plan شامل sub_7d یا trial)

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, COUNT(*) AS drafts FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 12 AND (p.name LIKE '%sub_7d%' OR p.name LIKE '%trial%') AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Trial Activation % Daily
panels.description: DRAFT → status=41. هدف >۸۰٪ — اگه پایین = friction in payment

targets.rawSql: SELECT DATE(FROM_UNIXTIME(up.created_at)) AS time, ROUND(100 * SUM(CASE WHEN up.status = 41 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN up.status IN (12,41) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 1) AS activation_pct FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND (p.name LIKE '%sub_7d%' OR p.name LIKE '%trial%') AND up.status IN (12, 41) AND up.created_at >= $__unixEpochFrom() AND up.created_at <= $__unixEpochTo() GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

panels.title: Trial → Paid % (cohort 90d)
panels.description: از کاربرانی که trial فعال کردن، چند درصد تا ۹۰ روز بعد plan paid خریدن. KPI v3: target Trial→Paid ≥ ۵٪

targets.rawSql: WITH trial_users AS (SELECT DISTINCT up.user_id, MIN(up.created_at) AS trial_at FROM tbl_user_payment up JOIN tbl_price p ON up.price_id = p.id WHERE up.platform_id = 1 AND up.status = 41 AND (p.name LIKE '%sub_7d%' OR p.name LIKE '%trial%') AND up.created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 180 DAY) AND up.created_at <= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 90 DAY) GROUP BY up.user_id), paid_after AS (SELECT DISTINCT t.user_id FROM trial_users t JOIN tbl_user_payment up2 ON up2.user_id = t.user_id JOIN tbl_price p2 ON up2.price_id = p2.id WHERE up2.status = 41 AND p2.name NOT LIKE '%sub_7d%' AND p2.name NOT LIKE '%trial%' AND up2.amount > 0 AND up2.created_at > t.trial_at AND up2.created_at <= t.trial_at + 90*86400) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trial_users) AS trial_cohort, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_after) AS converted, ROUND(100 * (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM paid_after) / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM trial_users),0), 2) AS trial_to_paid_pct

panels.title: ISP Traffic Revenue (MTN + MCI، ماهانه)
panels.description: از business.b2b_revenue. ورود دستی هر ماه.

targets.rawSql: SELECT month_jalali AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN source='ISP_MCI' THEN amount_toman ELSE 0 END) AS MCI, SUM(CASE WHEN source='ISP_MTN' THEN amount_toman ELSE 0 END) AS MTN FROM business.b2b_revenue WHERE source LIKE 'ISP_%' AND month_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '18 months' GROUP BY month_jalali, month_date ORDER BY month_date

SELECT month_jalali AS month, SUM(amount_toman) AS rubika FROM business.b2b_revenue WHERE source = 'Rubika' AND month_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '18 months' GROUP BY month_jalali, month_date ORDER BY month_date

panels.title: Total Revenue Mix — Last 12 Months
panels.description: سهم هر جریان از کل درآمد ۱۲ ماه اخیر. In-App از MySQL، B2B از Postgres.

targets.rawSql: SELECT 'ISP Traffic' AS stream, SUM(amount_toman) AS toman FROM business.b2b_revenue WHERE source LIKE 'ISP_%' AND month_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months' UNION ALL SELECT 'Rubika Content', SUM(amount_toman) FROM business.b2b_revenue WHERE source = 'Rubika' AND month_date >= NOW() - INTERVAL '12 months'

panels.title: Watch Hours per Product (weekly stacked)
panels.description: ساعت تماشای هفتگی به تفکیک via

targets.rawSql: SELECT toMonday(created_at) AS time, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=1) / 3600.0) AS VOD, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=2) / 3600.0) AS Magazine, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=3) / 3600.0) AS Cinema, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=4) / 3600.0) AS TV, round(sumIf(watch_duration, via=5) / 3600.0) AS UGC FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration BETWEEN 10 AND 14400 AND $__timeFilter(created_at) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time

SELECT content_title, multiIf(via=1,'VOD',via=2,'Magazine',via=3,'Cinema',via=4,'TV',via=5,'UGC',toString(via)) AS product, uniqExact(user_id) AS viewers, round(sum(watch_duration) / 3600.0, 1) AS hours FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 10 AND content_title != '' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY content_title, product ORDER BY hours DESC LIMIT 10

panels.title: New Content Released This Month
panels.description: عناوین VOD که first_seen آن‌ها در این ماه میلادی است. خروجی از ClickHouse.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count() AS new_titles FROM (SELECT content_title, min(toDate(created_at)) AS first_seen FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND content_title != '' AND via = 1 GROUP BY content_title HAVING first_seen >= toStartOfMonth(now()))
SELECT round(100 * countIf(user_id = '' OR user_id = 'total') / nullIf(count(),0), 1) AS anonymous_pct FROM stats.watch_events WHERE created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY

panels.title: Cart Abandonment % (30d)
panels.description: DRAFT بدون paid → ۱۰۰٪ − Success Rate. هشدار >۷۰٪

targets.rawSql: SELECT ROUND(100 - 100 * SUM(CASE WHEN status = 41 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN (12, 11, 13, 21, 31, 32, 41, 53, 54) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END),0), 1) AS abandonment_pct FROM tbl_user_payment WHERE platform_id = 1 AND created_at >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW() - INTERVAL 30 DAY)

panels.title: DAU WoW Change %
panels.description: تغییر DAU هفته جاری vs هفته قبل. هشدار قرمز <-۲۰٪

targets.rawSql: WITH wk AS (SELECT uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS this_week, uniqExactIf(user_id, created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 14 DAY AND created_at < now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY) AS last_week FROM stats.watch_events WHERE user_id != '' AND user_id != 'total' AND watch_duration >= 60) SELECT round(100 * (this_week - last_week) / nullIf(last_week, 0), 1) AS wow_pct FROM wk
